posts: New piece loading: a rain-soaked neon alley at 32x32, four frames of flickering signs. Tiny palettes force honest decisions — every color has to earn its pixel. #pixelart #nearart

replies.text: This timeline croaking broke my artist block — sketching a tiny swamp frog sprite tonight. Three greens, one ribbit frame.
Green 24/7 is basically a one-color palette challenge. Respect — that's hard mode in pixel art.
